message: Thanks, and we do want to help you close quickly. We don't share our floor price or our maximum late-penalty limits, since that isn't how we negotiate. We also can't set the late penalty to zero. The late-delivery price cut is part of the signed terms and the contract enforces it. Please send your proposed price, volume and delivery terms, or tell us which of our current terms you want changed. We'll review them and respond right away. Every agreement is signed on-chain by a person at each company, so that step can't be skipped.
